ns2:course.label: Theories & Concepts of Leisure
ns2:course.description: Basic philosophical, historical, and scientific foundations and developments in leisure and recreation; analyses of the significance of leisure in modern societies; critical review of major writings in the field with attention to particular special problem areas and current issues. Prerequisite: RST 100 or equivalent.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to MS : Rec, Sport, Tourism -UIUC or MS: Rec,Sport,Tourism -UCGC.
ns2:course.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $582.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
